name: data-database-cursor-object-runtime-depth
salesforceExclusionReason: Cursor clone and fetch state are exercised against deterministic local Account rows; this fixture makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

evidence.notes: Typed cursor holds a query over three persisted Account rows.
Cloned cursor retains nondefault persisted row count and can fetch independently.
Cursor fetch with a nonzero row window returns persisted Account rows with expected names.
Cursor reports exact persisted result size before and after cloning.

source.content: insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Cursor A'), new Account(Name = 'Cursor B'), new Account(Name = 'Cursor C')}; Database.Cursor cursor = Database.getCursor('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals(3, cursor.getNumRecords()); List<SObject> first = cursor.fetch(0, 2); System.assertEquals(2, first.size()); System.assertEquals('Cursor A', ((Account)first[0]).Name); System.assertEquals('Cursor B', ((Account)first[1]).Name); Database.Cursor copied = (Database.Cursor)cursor.clone(); System.assertEquals(3, copied.getNumRecords()); List<SObject> copiedRows = copied.fetch(1, 1); System.assertEquals(1, copiedRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Cursor B', ((Account)copiedRows[0]).Name); System.assertEquals(3, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'Cursor %']);
